scripts.install:global: dir="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}/bin" && mkdir -p "$dir" && for f in gent-cell gent; do cp "bin/$f" "$dir/.$f.new" && mv -f "$dir/.$f.new" "$dir/$f"; done && echo "Installed gent and gent-cell into $dir"
scripts.test: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 bun test --reporter=dots --preload ../../packages/tooling/src/test-preload.ts --parallel --path-ignore-patterns="**/headless-cli-exit.test.ts" tests
scripts.test:e2e: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 bun test --reporter=dots --preload ../../packages/tooling/src/test-preload.ts integration tests/headless-cli-exit.test.ts
